assumptions.reason: Recency sorting across signals only matters when multiple candidate instruments/signals compete for entry on the same day; the harness supplies a single instrument/feed, so there is never more than one signal to rank per day and the rule has no operative effect here.
Market cap is not derivable from OHLCV data and no external data source is available in this environment; declared as an infeasible gap per instructions rather than fabricating a proxy.

assumptions.choice: average dollar volume = SMA(Close * Volume, period=Y) compared against $1,000,000
assumptions.reason: Spec states the Y-day average volume must exceed a dollar amount ($N), so volume is interpreted as dollar volume (price x shares) rather than raw share count.

Spec explicitly overrides default sizing with 'fixed 100% of capital per trade'; the 1.001 factor reserves room for the 0.001 commission so the order is not margin-rejected. Uses current close as a proxy for execution price since the actual fill occurs at next bar's open.

assumptions.choice: checked intrabar via Low[0] <= stop_price and High[0] >= take_profit_price
assumptions.reason: Spec adds a 5%/10% stop-loss/take-profit but does not specify how the trigger is detected; using intraday High/Low against the actual filled entry price is the standard literal reading of a price level being 'hit'.

assumptions.topic: exit priority when multiple exit conditions match same bar
assumptions.choice: stop-loss checked first, then take-profit, then Z-day holding-period exit
assumptions.reason: Spec does not specify precedence among the three exit triggers; an explicit, deterministic order was chosen since backtrader can only submit one close order per bar.

assumptions.choice: period_open_day = Close[-Y], period_close_day = Close[0], i.e., a Y=10 trading-day lookback window
assumptions.reason: Spec defines the indicator as price_on_period_close_day / price_on_period_open_day using an interval 'of length Y days ending on the current day'; this is the direct literal implementation using trading-day bars (the only calendar available from the feed).

assumptions.choice: not implemented in the strategy class
assumptions.reason: Benchmarking and metrics reporting (total return, Sharpe, drawdown, win/loss counts) are backtest/analyzer configuration concerns handled by the harness's Cerebro setup, not logic belonging inside the bt.Strategy class.
